verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability to replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history after a tool is added or a pipeline breaks. Data Storage Destinations only store raw data. Reverse ETL syncs warehouse query results to destinations, which is an adjacent feature and a user-side workaround rather than event replay or backfill.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
